Paige: Paige is the name given to a cup of Earl Grey tea that’s been left too long. It would have been lovely had it been drunk sooner but now it’s cold, and is there anything more offensively drab than a cold cup of tea? (Note: If Paige is younger than 35 years old then she is a can of Red Bull. In which case, sure, drink one, strap a camera to your head and jump out of plane inside a canoe. Don't whinge to us if you get hurt.)
Paiten: Sure, she appears as a crazy and occasionally irresponsible girl, but is she really? For instance, yes, she regularly sneaks out her house to go and party while terribly under age, but at least she's had the good sense to write a comprehensive How-To guide based around this very life. She's no fool you see, and she's quite the entrepeneur. (In the back of the book she writes a small section on who to call if you get arrested and don't want your parents to find out.)
Palma: The brunette with quite a mysterious, sensual ‘look’. Doors open for Palma, and that’s fine, but there’s more suave elegance going on here than just her looks, ladies and gentlemen.
Pam: “Oh yeah,” she says, with a wave of the hand. "I know the kids will have themselves a party while we're away but, you know, they're good kids and we like their friends. And, anyway, didn't we do that when we were teenagers?"
Pamela: Pamela picked up a very nice Mercedes Benz from her divorce and she kept the house. She re-married her lawyer.
Pamela-Rose: Pamela-Rose suffers from a condition known as, Magazine Flanulatis. You’ll see them, these poor people, in the queue at the supermarket idly flicking through magazine after magazine. They literally cannot leave without buying one and no number of shrink visits can help them.
Pamelia: A large piece of sweet and nearly over-ripe chunk of citrus fruit. Pamelia has many fans, only a couple of enemies, not that she gives them any thought, and she is in your face if a situation isn't working. Naturally, she's a loud and genuine lover and fake orgasms are none of her business.
Pamella:
(Pronounced Parm-ella). So, another dinner party at Pamella’s house is there? No doubt she’ll pull out all the stops. If it’s anything like last time there’ll be Russian caviar and French bubbles, and more of that foie gras at a million dollars a pound, despite being a morally reprehensible food on every level. Anyway, that’s just the dinner. You should try being one of her children…

Private message from said child: I attend private school in Switzerland and I’m happy, but I hardly even know her. Is that bad? 
To be honest, I think the only reason they whisked us away was so they could fuck in one of the living rooms whenever they wanted, after doing lots of cocaine. They thought we never knew. I still love her though. She’s my mum. :)
Pamille: Artists sometimes come in the most unrecognisable forms, don’t they? Some  of them are disguised as engineers, others as ground-breaking architects while others are performance clowns, who can take a scene and flip it upside down in a way which is both surprising and brilliant. Pamille is one of these people. To look at her, you may not presume she is capable of great, functional art, given how well she dresses and how eloquently she speaks, but you probably just have to trust us here. She is a wonderful artist, no matter what she does, and that’s all there is to it. Amen.
Pandora: Yes, well, some names and some people aren't even names at all, are they? Take Pandora for instance. Larger than a person, Pandora is like the view you have when standing on a cliff top that overlooks the valley, the river at the bottom of it and the two or three townships dotted along it's edge as you peer down into the distance. Pandora, Pandora - the name given to a perfectly engaging and holistic view of the world and of life. It's all about peace, you see. And, honestly, what's the rush?
Paola: Sensual and giving, let's just pray that Paola never full grows up, ever!
Paris: The name of a fancy pair of red knickers.
Patrice: Cute, sexy, and blah blah blah. However, you will do well to go out of your way in order to stay on her good side as she is otherwise intolerable. Is she dangerous in this situation?? I don’t know...probably.
Patricia: Patricia, if she's called that, has certain ideals of behaviour and looks that she upholds. I suppose we all do in our own way, but Patricia is a name that flies up and down these short, steep rock mounds and so she expects a lot. Does that mean she frets over issues that, really, in the grand scheme of things don't amount to all that much? Well, yes it does, but, she's a loving soul and she'd benefit greatly from either yoga twice per week or perhaps even a meditation class once in a while.
Patrizia: See Noel, except it happens while you're at sea on a vessel, so there ain't no recovery this time!
Patsy:
It’s strange, isn't it, the effect some women have on people. Men have thrown themselves off cliffs over Patsy, for instance. Apparently she’s been proposed to at least 40 times. Aside from being basically hilarious, Patsy seems to invite moments of absurd coincidence that are generally the funniest thing you will ever witness. How is that? We don’t know. We just know we love having her around. Thanks Patsy. 
Love Management.
Patti: The deceptively potent Leader of the Pack.
Patti-Ann: Patti-Ann, please don't be too offended about this. It's purely a case of one name arriving into the commentary box before the other. So please head on over to your cousins house, Patty-Anne, and enjoy the show. Thee is they and they is thee. Amen.
Patty-Anne: "She's out the back," her husband says, all grumpy. He doesn't tell you of course, but they've just had a fight and Patty-Anne has gone out to vent her anger by weeding the vegie patch that she covets. It wasn't a huge fight, they're actually very loving to one another, but Patty-Anne won't back down if she believes in something. When you get to the garden, however, all that anger is long gone. She greets you with a huge smile and a hug, and so what if you've now got a bit of dirt on you. The tomatoes and beans she gives you will be worth it...
Paula: Paula is beautiful and she is charismatic, and she only just scraped passed the disaster without getting caught up in it. So, take a breath and relax baby.......you made it!
Paulette: Paulette bounces around with a cute and sexy smile for any and everyone, and she gives one of the worlds' great hugs, but as much as she adores her kids, she is absolutely useless at helping them with their maths homework.
Paulina: I know, you'd never pick it by watching her drive a motor car. Paulina is quite a gifted vet. I know, amazing eh?
Pauline: The very sexy bottle of antiseptic solution. If she’s in a bad mood you need to leave her in the cupboard. If not, well, bloody-well get the gloves on and get cleaning!
Payton: Payton ties her hair back so tightly that some of it is beginning to fall out. She thinks it's due to some kind of follicle disease and that is not the case, obviously. If asked why she pulls it back so tight, she'll say that she just likes having things neat.
Paz: What a wonderful, chilled-out lady. It's 6am, she's lying in bed having slept pretty well, even though the her kids were out late and, while they're not idiots, like all mums she’s concerned for their welfare. Now they're arriving home in a taxi she decides to get up. By the time they sneak in the front door she's already got the toaster and the kettle on, eager to hear the de-brief from all the fun and frivolity that went on last night. Paz.
Peachy: Peachy lives for getting tipsy and going skinny-dipping in the middle of the night.
Peg: No matter how bright it is, she refuses to wear sunglasses. "Now, how would I see the fuckin' ducks if I wore shades?" she asks, indignant, her double-barrel shotgun carried easily on her shoulder.
Peggy: What a life-giving babbling ball of bloody fun and love and splendid carry-on, she is.
Pela: Pela is 19 now. She cruised through high school and got into her preferred course at uni - she enrolled in arts but isn't really sure what she'll finish with - and right now she's on a boat off the Turkish coast. They're heading to Butterfly Valley with a mob she met at the backpackers in Instanbul, a few weeks back. She's the only Australian. She left her Aussie crew in London months ago, coz' she wanted to travel on her own for a while. Not that she ever gets much alone time. She's cute, she's smart, she's funny, she's got a wicked smile and people from all nationalities love her, and she harbours no fear about launching herself out into the world off on her own. It's just how it is.
Pember: Pember plump? Rubbish. She's loves the gym and she loves how she feels after a good hard session. This energy and verve are carried over into all aspects of her life, as a matter of fact, and she has a following.
Penelope: A full-bodied woman who has one of the most powerful voices in the Kingdom. She showers outside in her luscious garden whilst singing to her heart’s content and the townsfolk can hear her from miles away, although they think the same of her as anyone who meets her for the first time: that Penelope is highly talented, incredibly sexy and generally wonderful.
Penn: More sensitive than she sounds or seems, Penn is supremely reliable in all manner of situations. Improbably sexy, also. Her high level of intelligence is virtually a given.
Penni: Does Penni work herself up into fits of occasional stress and anxiety? Well, yes, sometimes she does. Performance matters, she will tell you, and when she perceives hers is lacking she does fret somewhat. Question is, should we, as outsiders, attempt to do anything about it? There's probably no harm in trying, but Penni has high standards so maybe just encourage her to go about what ever she is doing the best way she sees fit, and offer to rub her feet if she's feeling a little off, afterwards.
Penny: Penny is energetic and she means well, never flinching at a poor reaction to one or more of her directions, because who else is going to tell the fools how to behave and/or clean up after themselves?
Pepper: Gabriela, Isabella and Gisele: Pepper gives these girls a run for their money, any day.
Peppi: She's putting herself through university (law school) by dancing at one of New York's most exclusive nightclubs. Clearly, the girl can move and, boy, what a smile…
Perinne: Perinne kind of sneaks around there out the back. She gets things done and she's quite surprising in what she achieves and how she does it, but, like a male Parish, no one ever actually sees her do it. Things just get done almost by magic. It doesn't help that she keeps her fiercest reactions to herself, but this is the life, and this is the mysterious and quite lovely Perinne.
Peta: All of us have issues of some variety and Peta’s stem from having to repeatedly prove her femininity to the world. Not that she gives a shit, really, but the result is a tough and independent hombre. Peta is just wonderful.
Petra: One feels like one is standing in front of a Roman building built 2000 or more years ago, and out the front is an amazing marble sculpture of a goddess with wings: Petra.
Petrea: Slightly offbeat, Petrea manages great success in most things she attempts in life. As a somewhat impatient and competitive lass she goes quite hard and the rewards generally follow. However, she is contemplating a few small botox or collagen injections in her lips and her forehead. (Don't do it darlin! Management.)
Petria: As a brand new, very expensive and highly motorized Meccano set, Petria is a complicated lass who doesn’t tolerate fools, and who insists that all her screws are done up correctly and in the right order.
Petrina: Petrina walks the walk, she talks the talk, she’s sufficiently sensually picture-perfect and she takes no shit. You go girl!
Petronella: Some girls, no matter how dramatic and occasionally idiotic they can be, have their fathers wrapped around their little fingers. She's broken more hearts than the number of hot meals a poor person eats in a year, not that she knows too many of them.
Pheona: Pheona lives for filing things, be it moths in a museum collection, ice cores in an Antarctic research base or her own collection of teaspoons that she has amassed over the years.
Phil: There's no other way to say this, but Phil' is a ballsy girl whose got more grunt and get-up-and-go than most men. Gentlemen, you want to woo Phil'? Treat her very well and anticipate that she can look after herself. And, yes, that means you've got to bring a bit more to the table than normal. She can pick a fake a mile away.
Philipa: Hello Philipa, how are  you? I'd just thought I'd say hello and see how  you're going. Is life fun? You having a good time?....Excellent. Me too. Now, I should come clean here. Truth is, I know you think that the one 'l' is different to the two 'l' version of your name, likewise the multiple 'p', but I have some bad tidings for you. Indeed, I'm only talking to you for this long to keep your attention because, yes, you and your sisters are cut from the same chunk of stainless steel. Remember though that I, we and all of us love you. So, with that in mind, slip on out of here and slide on down to Phillipa for the mail, and if I ever see you out I'll buy you a drink.  True story. Love Management.
Philippa: Mmm, yes, we're been discussing you and your three sisters up here in the commentary box, Philippa. You're not going to dig this but c'est la vie. We suggest you head on over to Phillipa. Yeah, yeah, we know - the spelling isn't right. Suck it up baby. Life could be so much worse. And like we say, we'll buy you a drink if you ever drag your ego up here into the box. Management. x
Phillipa: Phillipa has the annoying habit of answering other peoples’ questions for them, especially when she’s bored. As a child she insisted that all of her friends play her games exactly as she intended and, in adulthood, nothing much has changed. (…oh come on Phil’…..that’s funny!)
Phoebe: Her father is certifiably insane, which explains why Phoebe is as complicated as she is. So it’s not her fault, classically speaking, but Phoebe is pretty cool. Keep an eye on her if you like, but she’ll be fine.
Phoenix: How can a person emulate what it is to be a phoenix, I ask you? It takes a while for her to find her feet in the world because all this attention and hype makes her avert her eyes, and makes her think inwardly about who she is and what she wants. In that regard maybe her parents did her a favour? The boys up here in the commentary box suspect she'll be used as a substitute late in the game when her guile and natural agility will take most of her opponents off guard. She might even be a secret weapon...
Phyllis: Phyllis is as rough as guts but she hugs harder than anyone.
Pia: Maximally attentive and lovely, Pia exists here in this moment, all the time. It’s an impressive skill.
Pierina: Pierina is like one of those dignified flamingos who possess style and grace. Many people would say she has a decent sized ego and that maybe true, but don't forget that without a strong belief that you are going to do well, chances are you won't. Sure, she seems aloof once in a while but only if you're an idiot, so who knows, maybe her behaviour is doing you a favour? She'll never be homeless and she'll never be bankrupt for long, that's for sure.
Pieta: Pieta has a very healthy scalp and she's not prone to wastage.
Pina: Her kids are polite and outgoing, and they take calculated risks, which says everything about this woman. Pina is strong-willed, sexy and lovely and not to be taken lightly.
Pip: Perfect to take into battle, Pip is passionate and single-minded, her decisions are made in a flash and her general level of sexiness makes the outcomes of such decisions even better….generally.
Piper: Interestingly, Piper is the middle sister of Pip and Pippa. As a man called Alby in a past life, she runs the rorts, takes the cash, laughs hard with the cops who she's in cahoots with, and generally has a rip-roaring time from start to finish, no matter what she's up to.
Pippa: Borderline adrenaline junkie. As one of the few female bullfighters in existence, she loves being in the centre of the arena where her decisions really matter, and where she can singlehandedly thrill the crowd.
Pixie: Pixie is the name of a special type of cardio-toxin. If ingested even in tiny quantities you'll laugh so hard that you end up having a fucking heart attack.
PJ: Wonder Woman – and we’re talking the invisible jet, the legs, the playful smile, the physics degree etc etc. An she’s more than happy to share a joke with the boys.
Po: Po is centred, spiritually content and intelligently poised, and all of this makes her even more attractive than she already is. Indeed, Po deserves a round of applause....
Polly: You wake up really late and leap out of bed before running out the door while still half asleep: this is called the Polly Moment. It feels crazy, painful and illogical at the start but everything turns out to be wonderful in the end. It always does.
Pollyanna: Supremacy in the bedroom: this is what Pollyanna likes. (For her, that is.) Otherwise her and Monica are very close cousins.
Poppy: Poppy is hard to miss and impossible to ignore. She has excellent posture and she always gets what she wants.
Portia: I know, it's almost a cliché but what can you do. Portia is magic dust and you don't see it everyday.
Possum: Way more potent than the male version, Possum is watchful and ready. Funny as fuck, as well, but she can jump into action in a flash.
Prakaash: Indian, and no, not the American horse-riding variety. Prakaash is as physically gorgeous as she is funny and skillfully business-minded. She has a lightning wit, can turn tragedy into success in a flash and she treats all people equally. Prakaash probably needs to be in politics, but she wouldn't tolerate the ego-filled cock-heads she’d be surrounded by, and we don’t blame her. God bless you Prakaash, and be he/she/they Hindi Gods or otherwise.
Pria: A single-minded bird of prey who is both starving and impatient, so lookout!!
Prickles:
The attendees of that New York fund raising dinner, last year, are still talking to their shrinks about her. Prickles never goes formal, normally, but she was convinced to rock along by a man who didn't know her well. So, there were 20 people at the table and someone had just begun to give a speech - the mayor may have even been there - when her date whispers something in her ear in answer to her quiet question about the drinks. At his response, she frowns hard and looks around at her fellow guests.
“What?” she says aloud, stopping the orator in his tracks. “None of these tossers drink beer? What kind of a bullshit dinner is this?”
Princess: Princess is one of the most potent female names and not just anyone can pull it off. Indeed, it’s not possible for an individual to carry the name Princess, and not actually be some kind of Princess. In short, Princess is physically and spiritually beautiful and, without doubt, she is one of the funniest human beings you’ll ever meet.
Pru:
Oh shut up with your whinging and give it here,' she says to her useless husband. She grabs the shovel, pushes him out of the way and says, 'This is how you dig a trench. I'll do the first two metres and you can do the rest. If you don't do it right I'll come back out here and slap you over the head.'

Oddly enough, the majority of gals called Pru end up in either law or politics.
Prudence: What an amazing irony. Anyway, if Earth is ever visited by aliens in a humungous fucking spaceship one day then be rest assured that, no matter what the inhabitants of such a craft are like and no matter why they are here, the name of the spaceship will be, The Prudence. She's looks odd, she's kind of sexy in a way that makes you want see what it's like to rub your face against her, and while she appears harmless enough, you're pretty sure that you don't want to piss her off any time soon. Prudence.
Prue: Prue was born on a planet that exists light years from earth and she arrived here in a space ship, which is why she might seem a little odd. Nowadays, having never acclimatised to our stronger gravitational field, she is always very thin and she struggles with any kind of physical exertion. This actually provides her with great comfort for so long as she is thought of as being anorexic and frail she will always be thought of as being human, and this is all she ever wanted. (She’s not the least bit dangerous.)
Prunella: The perfect English host in the ideal English garden, unless you earn less than £200,000/year, in which case she'll sick the dogs onto you.
